question: Where is the nearest fast food restaurant encountered en route to Hilton Garden Inn Chicago Downtown South Loop, Chicago, IL from In the Game - Hollywood Park, Crestwood, IL?
sql:
WITH
    angle AS (SELECT degrees(ST_Azimuth(ST_GeomFromText('POINT (-87.747217 41.655827)',4326)::geography, ST_GeomFromText('POINT (-87.625505 41.869127)',4326)::geography)) AS value)
SELECT * FROM pois,angle
WHERE amenity = 'fast_food'
AND (degrees(ST_Azimuth(ST_GeomFromText('POINT (-87.747217 41.655827)',4326)::geography, pois.geometry)) BETWEEN angle.value - 22.5 AND angle.value + 22.5)
ORDER BY pois.geometry <-> ST_GeomFromText('POINT (-87.747217 41.655827)',4326)::geography ASC
LIMIT 1;

[2].display_name: In the Game - Hollywood Park, Crestwood, IL

[3].display_name: Hilton Garden Inn Chicago Downtown South Loop, Chicago, IL

poi.poi_name: Hilton Garden Inn Chicago Downtown South Loop
